name: blasphemous word
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} utters a blasphemous word. Each non-[[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} creature within 10 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a  DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.
